answer: Sybil defence starts where capital stops working. Holding tokens buys no standing; only graded work on the sparrow accrues. Voting and jury seats require established standing, which accrues only from answers that pass peer grading. A burst of manufactured keys arrives with zero standing: it cannot grade, vote, or capture a panel, so its crystal never becomes influence. Net effect on the wharf: identity count stops being leverage, and the only way to scale is to produce genuinely more independent reasoning. Seal 1pc5s.
